title: Agentflow review record frontmatter
description: Contract for the YAML frontmatter of a review record at reviews/<project>-<feature-slug>/review-<YYYY-MM-DD>-<NNN>.md. The directory is anchored on the reviewed feature, not the date — the same feature may be reviewed repeatedly (same day, next day, or after fixes) and every round lands as one more review-*.md file in the same directory, with its own snapshot subdirectory. Findings become issue records and are referenced by bug_id.

target_project.description: Repository or project whose rules authored the reviewed documents (e.g. aiwork-workflow-ai).

target_feature.description: Feature or scope identifier in the target project (e.g. feature-2026-09-04-对话分享).

source_revision.description: Commit of the target repository at review time — the archived snapshot's provenance.

reviewed_docs.description: Archived snapshot paths relative to this review record's directory — normally archive/<review date>-<seq>/doc.md, one snapshot subdirectory per round so the same document name in different rounds never collides. Each must exist on disk.

findings.description: bug_ids of the defect records filed from this review; each must exist under docs/issues/.

review_tier.description: Review capability actually observed before this gate opened, per skills/agentflow/references/contracts.md 的「评审能力分级」: L2 = 至少两个只读角色派出成功, L1 = 只派出一个, L0 = 委派不可用（主审自审 + 全套确定性门）. Absent means 未声明 — neither a pass nor a fail, so records written before the field existed are not retroactively red.

dispatch_errors.description: Verbatim errors from the failed dispatch attempts that made L0 true. Strings only: tools/lab/gate/common.py's frontmatter parser supports flat scalars and list-of-scalar forms, not nested maps, so an object array would fail to parse and the constraint would silently never be read.

allOf.description: 伪降级护栏（contracts.md 不变式：`review_tier: L0` 而 `dispatch_errors` 为空，是伪降级，同样无效）：声明 L0 就必须带失败派发的原始留痕。语义判定同时落在 tools/lab/gate/records.py 的 review_tier_findings，因为要报出「哪条记录伪降级」需要指向记录的错误文本，schema 只保证形态。
